s: Humph, Joy's Angry!BuffJoy becomes Angry! each time her skill hits a non-Minion enemy, dealing 100 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Magic Damage and increasing her Movement Speed by 60% that decays over 4s (hitting the Leonin Crystal will also grant the Movement Speed effect). This effect has a cooldown of 4s for each target.Joy's Basic Attack will deal 65 (+65% Total Physical Attack) (+65% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.

Look, Leonin Crystal!SummonJoy summons a Leonin Crystal at the target location, dealing 200 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 30% for 1s.The Leonin Crystal lasts 2 seconds and can be used as a springboard for her second skill,  Meow, Rhythm of Joy!.

Meow, Rhythm of Joy!Mobility DamageJoy dashes in the target direction, dealing 120 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in her path. Hitting an enemy or the Leonin Crystal allows Joy to cast this skill again within 0.8 seconds and gain 1 Beat Energy. Casting this skill on the beat increases the skill damage by 100% and grants a 80 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage shield that lasts 3s.This skill can be cast up to 4 times in succession.

Ha, Electrifying Beats!AOE Speed UpJoy increases her Physical & Magic Defense by 15 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and gains 30% Movement Speed. Over the next 4s, she pulses 8 times, dealing 120 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage each time to nearby enemies.Each Meow, Rhythm of Joy! cast on the beat increases this skill's damage by 40%. If perfect rhythm is achieved by hitting every beat with Meow, Rhythm of Joy!, Joy also gains 40% Spell Vamp while this skill is active.This skill unlocks when Joy acquires Beat Energy. Casting this skill with 3 Beat Energy will remove all debuffs on Joy and make her immune to slow effects while this skill is active.
